scope: Independent /height_maps producer for ThreePhase START_ALIGN/GOAL_ALIGN rotation checks; no Nav2/map/scan/MPPI changes.

tag_formats.map_from_world: x y z roll pitch yaw, explicit required transform
tag_formats.known_xy_bounds: xmin ymin xmax ymax in map frame
tag_formats.ground_z: finite ground height in map frame

contract.free: cells completely inside explicitly known XY rectangle after complete environment collision capture
contract.unknown: outside known rectangle, its straddling cells, outer grid border, or invalidated previous bundle
contract.geometry: BOX and loaded actual MESH triangle surfaces; slab clipping plus closed-component interiors
contract.unsupported_geometry: explicit exception and invalidation; no silent omission
contract.payload_exclusion: read_execution attached=true and parent_model=robot_model, current capture and no transition/error
contract.refresh: full collision roster/geometry/pose/ownership checked; changed revision rebuilds full bundle, unchanged data reused only after recheck
contract.point_counts: zero: geometry producer has no sampled point-cloud input

checks.shape_conversion: BOX 12 faces; real Wall/Ground/ShelfD units, node transforms, URI and scale/pose; explicit unsupported/missing failures

warehouse_models.frame: model local plus actual link/collision pose

execution_phase_source.writer: kinematic_payload.cpp:66-94 writes current info.simTime capture in PreUpdate

limitations: No shared colcon build or plugin load performed here; root owns these.
No ROS/DDS/runtime freshness, actual world-map identity, ground calibration, payload transition, robot motion or alignment acceptance here.
Only BOX/MESH needed by current scene supported; other geometry fails explicitly.
Open/nonmanifold mesh components contribute actual surfaces only; exact-coordinate welding does not repair gaps.
Closed connected components use parity interiors by union; nested independent shells are conservatively occupied.
True known XY domain and ground/world-map transform must be supplied and validated by the session owner.
